name: Jira Sprint Health Monitor & Daily Digest

parameters.content:
## 1. Triggers
Weekday 09:00 schedule (workflow timezone), manual run, or authenticated POST /webhook/sprint-health/run with optional {"dryRun":true} or {"force":true}.

## 2. Config + state
All tunables in Config, validated on every run (bad values or a workflow/Config timezone mismatch stop the run and alert admins). State lives in two n8n Data Tables (created automatically): sprint_digest_recipients (who gets the digest) and sprint_health_runs (claims + daily snapshots).

## 3. Jira REST (paginated)
Every call goes through the "Jira GET" sub-workflow: startAt/isLast or nextPageToken paging, honours Retry-After on 429/503, exponential backoff with jitter on 5xx/network errors, no retry on other 4xx. Limits from Config.jira*.

## 4. Analyze
Buckets To Do / In Progress / Done / Blocked, flags stale (>3d In Progress), overdue, unassigned, blocked; completion %, workload, health, day-over-day delta; renders the email.

## 5. Claim-before-send
Insert a pending claim, read back all claims for the same sprint+date, lowest live id wins. Loser marks itself lost. Winner emails one at a time (retries never re-send a delivered digest), then records sent/failed.
